name: Mealie
description: Import recipes by URL, plan meals, build shopping lists and scale servings. Modern UI with PWA support.
compose:
services:
  mealie:
    image: hkotel/mealie:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9000"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    restart: unless-stopped
